meta.title: Grand Bahama Institutional Reference
meta.methodology: Curated from official gazettes, election results reporting, and Department of Local Government public materials. Officer names are included only when confirmed in public reporting; unconfirmed roles are left null.
meta.framing: Module 01 of the Grand Bahama Digital Government Platform. Invest Grand Bahama (GBPA) maps investment activity inside the Port Area. This module covers government institutional structure for Grand Bahama — Ministry portfolio, parliamentary representation, and local-government districts — as a complementary public data layer, not a competing investment map.

ministry.name: Ministry for Grand Bahama
ministry.minister: The Hon. Ginger Maria Moxey, M.P.
portfolio: Relations with the Grand Bahama Port Authority
Revitalization & Promotion of Grand Bahama as a Tourism and Industrial Centre
Promotion of Agricultural Development in Grand Bahama
Advancement of Health and Educational Infrastructure
Promotion of Employment and Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Grand Bahama
Community Relocation and Restoration in East and West Grand Bahama
Relations with Urban Renewal — Grand Bahama
Relations with Disaster and Risk Management Reconstruction Authority — Grand Bahama
Relations with Grand Lucayan Resorts Operations
Community Engagement and Empowerment — Grand Bahama
notes: No Minister of State or Parliamentary Secretary is currently attached to this ministry.

Development of the Freeport International Airport appeared in the 2021 portfolio but not in the 2026 gazette; Relations with Freeport Airport Development Company now sits under the Ministry of Energy, Utilities and Aviation.
The Ministry runs a stakeholder-coordination unit called Collab: Partnerships for Development.
ministry.source: Official Gazette — Allocation of Portfolios, May 19, 2026
